      mvcc.isKeyBackendG b (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) (mvcc.kbNoCmpF γ.kb γ.bucket)
        (mvcc.storePutOk γ) Del (mvcc.storeW s γ) (mvcc.kbWi γ.kb) iprop(True) (mvcc.storeCmp γ) P (mvcc.hookFn γ)
        (mvcc.storeReq γ) (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.storeBt γ) (mvcc.kbSR γ.kb) (mvcc.kbSRh γ.kb) (mvcc.kbMWv γ.kb γ.bucket)
        (mvcc.kbHookNilAt γ.kb))

    IProp GF) : mvcc.storeBackendT b s γ P ⊢ mvcc.storeSessT b s γ P
